name: bran
description: Compile and audit executable branching-story packages and reproducible media-production handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Compile story packages and media-production handoffs
interface.longDescription: Turn source material and world rules into validated branching-story packages with typed actions, multi-seat visibility, replay variants, deterministic settlement, optional storyboard preparation, provider-neutral generation tasks, media provenance, and reproducible export receipts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $bran to compile and validate this branching story package and its media-production handoff.
